metadataRaw.title: 3 Moves to Instantly Relieve Hip Pain (Using Just a Chair)
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows three easy chair exercises that can help give both quick and long-lasting hip pain relief.

These exercises will focus on lengthening and strengthening the main muscles that cause hip pain, and can also help improve hip mobility and flexibility. 

Let us know how they work for you!

Chapters: 
0:00 Hamstrings Release 
1:31 Glutes and Piriformis Release
2:57 Strengthening Exercise
